# 1 Enoch Chapter 107 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 107:1 — 'summed them up for him'

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "summed-them-up-for-him" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "summed them up for him" | Formal |
| PNEUMA | "I summed it all up for him" | 'It all' for 'them'; colloquial |

**SOPHIA:** Adopted LOGOS. Minor stylistic difference; both are equivalent. LOGOS preserves the pronoun reference to 'parables/secrets' (them).

---

## 107:2 — Noah's name etymology: 'comfort' vs. 'rest'

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "he-will-comfort-the-earth after-all-the-destruction" | 'Comfort' for nuah |
| LOGOS | "he will comfort the earth after all the destruction" | Formal; 'comfort' |
| PNEUMA | "this child will bring comfort to the earth after all the destruction" | 'Bring comfort to' is slightly more expanded |

**SOPHIA:** Adopted LOGOS. 'He will comfort the earth' is the direct rendering. The Ge'ez nuah can mean both 'rest' (as in Genesis 5:29 MT) and 'comfort' (as in LXX). 'Comfort' is preferred here as it is the more emotionally significant meaning in context.

---

## 107:3 — 'a different son' vs. 'another son'

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "A-different-son-was-born-to-him" | 'Different' suggests otherness |
| LOGOS | "Another son was born to him" | 'Another' is natural |
| PNEUMA | "another son was born to him" | Agrees with LOGOS |

**SOPHIA:** Adopted LOGOS 'Another son.' 'Different' (EMET) could imply the child was unusual; the Ge'ez simply means 'another/a second.' The distinction matters since Nir's miraculous qualities (if any) are not mentioned here.

---

**Total disagreements this chapter: 3**
